Container.Name: Tellyard
Container.Overview: A live TV tuner for Plex and Jellyfin that you'll forget is running.[br][br]Tellyard shows up in Plex and Jellyfin as a network tuner. You list your channels in one file. When someone tunes in, Tellyard finds the channel's live stream on YouTube, Twitch, a broadcaster's page or an HLS address and passes it on without re-encoding. When they stop watching, it stops. The guide merges XMLTV schedules with placeholder blocks, so it is never empty.[br][br]Tellyard ships no channels. It starts with an empty line-up: put your channels.toml in /mnt/user/appdata/tellyard/config and it is loaded within a minute. Then add the tuner in Plex at UNRAID-IP:5004 and the guide at http://UNRAID-IP:5004/guide.xml.
Container.Requires: Plex or Jellyfin, and a channels.toml listing the live streams you may watch. Tellyard ships no channels.
Container.Changes:
### 0.1.3 - 2026-11-01
#### Changed
- Stop yt-dlp from sending a made-up address in another country to sites that limit streams by region. A `live` channel limited to another region now fails with the site's region error. - Start guide placeholder blocks at local midnight in `TZ` instead of UTC. A `TZ` that is not a known time zone name logs a warning and keeps UTC.
#### Fixed
- Report the error yt-dlp gives when a stream cannot be opened, such as a region limit, instead of its last hint line. - Read guide times that name their time zone as `UTC` or `GMT`. Log the entries whose times cannot be read. - Keep building the guide when a guide source lists a show that ends far in the future. All channels lost their guide. - Rebuild the guide after the system clock is set back. It stopped updating until the clock caught up. - Read guide times that have no space before the time zone offset. They were read as UTC. - Read guide times without seconds or minutes, such as `202610111530 +0300`. They were read at the wrong time. - Log the time the last good copy of a guide source was downloaded, also after a retry. - Play streams and pass the container health check when `http_proxy` is set. Both sent requests meant for Tellyard itself to the proxy. - Refuse a guide source with an entry nested more than 8 levels deep. A few such entries made the guide hundreds of megabytes. - Play HLS streams whose master playlist starts with a blank line. - Keep the later shows of the last good copy of a guide source when a new download ends earlier or lacks a channel. Those hours showed placeholder blocks until the next rebuild. - Log why the last good copy of a guide source was not used when a channel falls back to placeholder blocks. - Keep the last good copy of a guide source readable when it holds shows with long text in a non-Latin script. Those channels showed placeholder blocks when the source failed. - Keep updating the guide when a guide source names a text encoding Python does not know. The guide stopped updating for all channels. - Keep the shows after the guide window in the last good copy of a guide source. While a source stayed shorter than its copy, the later shows ran out after one rebuild. - Rebuild the guide when `channels.toml` changes while the guide is being built. New or renamed channels stayed out of the guide until the next scheduled rebuild. - Stop the Deno helper when a channel lookup is cancelled or takes too long. It kept running. - Clean up finished helper processes when the container runs without `--init`. The image now starts with tini. - Stop yt-dlp and Deno when `tellyard check` or `tellyard serve` is stopped with Ctrl-C during a channel lookup.
#### Security
- Update Python to 3.13.18, which rejects the compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates in every TLS connection (CVE-2026-115557).

Config.Name: Tuner Port
Config.Description: Port Plex and Jellyfin use for the tuner, the guide and the /healthz check.

Config.Name: Channels
Config.Description: Folder with your channels.toml. Tellyard reloads it within a minute of a change.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Guide and yt-dlp caches. Rebuilt when missing.

Config.Name: Tuners
Config.Description: Streams that may play at the same time.

Config.Name: Minimum Height
Config.Description: Lowest resolution tellyard check accepts, such as 1080. off accepts any. A channel's own min_height in channels.toml overrides it.

Config.Name: Device ID
Config.Description: 8 hexadecimal characters. Plex remembers the tuner by this.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Address Plex should use, such as http://192.168.1.10:5004. Set it when the address Plex connects with is not reachable for streams.

Config.Name: Guide Refresh Hours
Config.Description: How often the guide is rebuilt.

Config.Name: yt-dlp Arguments
Config.Description: Extra yt-dlp arguments, for example extractor options.

Config.Name: Heartbeat URL
Config.Description: Address Tellyard calls once a minute while it is healthy, for a monitor such as Uptime Kuma or Healthchecks.
